To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the teleportation of a quantum state between a sender and receiver can be realized with the control of many uncooperative supervisors in a network, if the sender and receiver have shared a suitable entangled state.
we introduce a new controlled teleportation protocol with the endurance against uncooperations of part of supervisors and we also give the corresponding entanglement distribution scheme.
we introduce another kind controlled teleportation protocol with other types entanglement channel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to realize controlled teleportation in a network with the help of some entangled states as a quantum channel and the cooperation of many participants.
the controlled quantum teleportation with entanglement channels of various types, which is of fundamental significance for the future quantum information processing.

the problem of how to achieve the controlled teleportation of an arbitrary quantum state from Alice to Bob via the control of multiple supervisors with high degree of resistance against the uncooperation of the supervisors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GHZ-type entangle state is not the only choice of the entangled channel in controlled teleportation protocols.

the controlled teleportation can be realized in two ways: (i) with the cooperation of all supervisors; and (ii) with the cooperation only of part of the supervisors, but with the help of some other entangled states as the quantum channel.

the controlled teleportation of an arbitrary unknown quantum state between Alice and Bob via the control of multiple supervisors can be realized with GHZ-type, W-type and GHZ-type entangles states as quantum channel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a new kind of teleportation protocols with the quantum channel of other types of entanglement states.
the controlled teleportation can be realized by the entangled states of different kinds, such as GHZ state and W state.

, the GHZ-type entangling state is the best choice for the controlled teleportation with full cooperation, while the other types of entangling states are more robust for the controlled teleportaton with uncooperation of some supervisors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the teleportation of a quantum state can be achieved with high degree of robustness against uncooperation, and the robustness is determined by the entanglement of the quantum channel.
the teleportation can still be achieved with the help of the entanglement channel even if some of the supervisors do not cooperate.
, in order to achieve the task of controlled teleportation, we can choose the quantum channel from a wider class of entangled states.
